'''Rowrakruk''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that was part of the [[Wawaatt Archipelago/Legends|Wawaatt Archipelago]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Wookiee [[Tarkov]] and his son [[Jaccoba]] discovered the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invasion force. They warned the cities of the archipelago, but the cities, including Rowrakruk, soon fell to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] invaders.<ref name="Databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rowrakruk was first mentioned in the now-defunct [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Tarkov, a character from the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' animated tv series.
